source_version_rule: Use the source packet's checked S/RES/2790(2025) OP6,7,9; preserve subsequent amendments and specific administrative approvals separately.
proposed_custodian_roles: UNSCOL recipient property, procurement and finance custodians
Competent donor release and designated-recipient approval authorities

period_parameters.rule: Custodians must approve comparable observation windows and accrual/commitment treatment before collection.

authority_boundary: OP9 requires safe transfer to the designated entity under UN practices and financial rules. It does not name UNSCOL, approve these particular assets or supersede withdrawal/security/medical capability and liquidation protection under OP6–7.

field_level_additions.grain: One specific release/recipient approval scope or signed custody decision; not a generic resolution paragraph

fields.name: approval_token
fields.purpose: Stable reference to the specific administrative authority and custody decision.

fields.name: asset_or_lot_token
fields.purpose: Custodian-held mapping to serialized asset or stock lot; do not disclose raw VIN/serial in Git.

fields.name: designated_recipient_entity
fields.purpose: Establish that this recipient, rather than merely an unspecified entity, was designated.

fields.name: authority_instrument_receipt
fields.purpose: Identify competent approval under applicable financial/property rules.

fields.name: approval_scope
fields.purpose: Record included asset class, quantity boundary and conditions.

fields.name: approval_date
fields.purpose: Establish approval chronology before release.

fields.name: effective_period_start
fields.purpose: Match approval coverage to transfer events.

fields.name: effective_period_end
fields.purpose: Identify expiry or explicitly reviewed open-ended authority.

fields.name: donor_release_receipt
fields.purpose: Verify authorized donor release.

fields.name: recipient_acceptance_receipt
fields.purpose: Verify authorized physical custody acceptance separately from a proposed receiving need.

fields.name: approving_role_code
fields.purpose: Record competent role without personal identifiers.

field_level_additions.grain: One asset or lot quantity allocated to one approved recipient need/procurement line

fields.name: allocation_token
fields.purpose: Prevent repeated substitution credit for the same quantity.

fields.name: asset_or_lot_token
fields.purpose: Match current donor and recipient inventories with private serial/lot crosswalk.

fields.name: procurement_requirement_token
fields.purpose: Reuse the E02 requirement key rather than creating a second need population.

fields.name: approved_need_receipt
fields.purpose: Establish legitimate recipient demand before transfer.

fields.name: inventory_snapshot_date
fields.purpose: Use a dated current inventory and distinguish already-held spare capacity.

fields.name: condition_assessment_receipt
fields.purpose: Support condition, remaining useful life and suitability for the actual need.

fields.name: remaining_life_or_expiry_receipt
fields.purpose: Use assessed life for equipment and expiry/quality for consumable lots.

fields.name: allocated_quantity
fields.purpose: Quantify proposed/actual replacement in matching units without assuming one asset equals one procurement line.

fields.name: quantity_unit
fields.purpose: Prevent mixing counts, lots, litres or service capacity.

fields.name: substitution_coverage_receipt
fields.purpose: Evidence equivalent functionality; record partial replacement and remaining need.

field_level_additions.grain: One commitment/cancellation event for an existing recipient procurement requirement

fields.name: procurement_event_token
fields.purpose: Distinguish original need, commitment, cancellation and correction events.

fields.name: procurement_requirement_token
fields.purpose: Link to existing E02 need and asset allocation.

fields.name: procurement_line_token
fields.purpose: Link requisition/PO line without exposing vendor or banking details in public derivatives.

fields.name: event_date
fields.purpose: Determine whether expenditure was avoidable at the decision date.

fields.name: commitment_status
fields.purpose: Distinguish uncommitted plan, cancellable order, irreversible liability and actual receipt.

fields.name: cancellation_receipt
fields.purpose: Authenticate cancellation where claimed; absence is an explicit missing input.

fields.name: noncancelable_liability
fields.purpose: Retain actual unavoidable liabilities rather than crediting full cancelled headline price.

fields.name: currency
fields.purpose: Match monetary units.

fields.name: counterfactual_purchase_receipt
fields.purpose: Evidence the necessary external purchase, price, period and remaining demand; list book value separately.

field_level_additions.grain: One applicable protection/readiness reservation or release clearance for an asset or lot

fields.name: reservation_token
fields.purpose: Preserve every material hold or approved clearance.

fields.name: asset_or_lot_token
fields.purpose: Prevent releasing a resource still required for withdrawal or liquidation.

fields.name: reservation_function
fields.purpose: Classify security, medical/evacuation, enabling support, protected withdrawal or liquidation guard requirement at minimum necessary detail.

fields.name: reservation_status
fields.purpose: Distinguish current hold, conditional release and authorized clearance.

fields.name: clearance_receipt
fields.purpose: Evidence competent operational acceptance without disclosing tactical details.

fields.name: assessed_period
fields.purpose: Match withdrawal/liquidation or receiving-service need.

fields.name: guardrail_review_receipt
fields.purpose: Link prospective service, safety and readiness assessment; numerical thresholds remain unset pending actual baseline.

field_level_additions.grain: One unique external cost object or eliminated internal pair in a matched period/counterfactual

fields.name: cost_component_token
fields.purpose: Deduplicate components across C02 and C13/Lebanon transition pool.

fields.name: asset_or_lot_token
fields.purpose: Associate cost with transfer or protected residual need.

fields.name: procurement_requirement_token
fields.purpose: Associate counterfactual acquisition or remaining demand.

fields.name: cost_class
fields.purpose: Separate transport, refurbishment, installation, security/medical support, residual guards, storage, operating cost and foregone disposal proceeds.

fields.name: external_or_internal
fields.purpose: Eliminate internal transfers once while retaining underlying external cost.

fields.name: internal_pair_token
fields.purpose: Pair internal debit/credit only when applicable, with explicit nonapplicability review.

fields.name: amount
fields.purpose: Record evidenced component amount; no imputed zero for missing cost.

fields.name: currency
fields.purpose: Preserve monetary unit.

fields.name: accrual_or_commitment_period
fields.purpose: Keep matched financial periods and distinguish cash, accrual and commitment.

fields.name: cost_evidence_receipt
fields.purpose: Support actual or counterfactual amount and provenance.

fields.name: existing_aggregate_component
fields.purpose: Show inclusion in existing E02 transfer_cost/residual_liability_cost; component lines are not additional amounts to add again.

join_and_recognition_rules: All serial/VIN/lot and person/vendor re-identification maps stay with approved custodians outside Git; stable opaque tokens support restricted joins.
Asset/lot allocation quantities may not exceed verified available quantity or approved unmet need; do not multiply one benefit through many-to-many joins.
Specific recipient designation, donor release, physical acceptance and procurement cancellation are distinct receipts; none substitutes for another.
Cost components reconcile to the existing E02 aggregate fields and C13 shared transition pool; do not add components to their own parent totals.
Retain noncancelable commitments and residual security/medical/guard costs; incomplete components withhold computation.
The already proposed 438100 USD is baseline context. No incremental benefit is recognized from its repetition or from asset book values.
handling: Extend E02 approved-system-only handling, minimum disclosure, pseudonymization, access and retention rules unchanged; no collection authorization is supplied.
stop_and_review_rule: Do not dispatch or activate until custodians accept scope, authority, handling, extraction burden, comparable periods and prospective safeguards. A protected-capability hold or uncertain recipient authority blocks operational release.
